## First Place at the Deloitte x DCU Student Business Consulting Case Competition!🎉 

Last week, we had the incredible opportunity to act as hashtag#strategy hashtag#consultants for Apple’s entry into the hashtag#AI market through hashtag#Apple hashtag#Intelligence. 

The challenge? Develop a persuasive solution and presentation in just 8 hours - a true test of hashtag#teamwork, hashtag#adaptability, and hashtag#strategic thinking. 

This was my first case competition with such tight constraints and a team I met that very morning. Drawing on my hashtag#internship experience, past hashtag#presentations, and coursework in Business Strategy and Managing Digital Change and Transformation at Dublin City University, I hashtag#led our team to success. 

A special thanks to my teammates, Karol Koszorz and Marleen Danzenbächer (first year Global Business students at DCU Business School) for their outstanding contributions and initiative. 

Excited to take on more consulting challenges in the future!
